subject: Geografia
description_pt: Analisar modificações de paisagens por diferentes tipos de sociedade, com destaque para os povos originários.

components.description_pt: Identificar modificações da paisagem realizadas por diferentes tipos de sociedades
components.description_en: Identify landscape modifications made by different types of societies

components.description_pt: Descrever como povos indígenas transformaram e manejaram paisagens
components.description_en: Describe how Indigenous peoples transformed and managed landscapes
components.cc_component_description: Identify natural resources that humans use and describe how those resources support human activities

components.description_pt: Comparar modificações de paisagens realizadas por povos indígenas com as de outras sociedades
components.description_en: Compare landscape modifications made by Indigenous peoples with those of other societies
components.cc_component_description: Compare how different societies developed based on the resources available in their environments

cc_matches.description: Living things need water, air, and resources from the land, and they live in places that have the things they need. Humans use natural resources for everything they do.
Resource availability has guided the development of human society.
